title: thelypteris fragrans
intro: Thelypteris fragrans, commonly known as the fragrant lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta. The health benefits of Thelypteris fragrans include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
